pages.text: Individual homes stay $(thing)simple$(0). The builds that make a city breathe are its $(thing)shared works$(0) — workshops, taverns, bathhouses, monuments — that many citizens draw on at once.$(br2)A shared structure serves up to a set number of $(thing)users$(0), so as your population grows you raise more of them. Infrastructure scales with people, not with any one citizen.

This is where your effort as a builder pays off. A grand tavern that satisfies a drink need for many citizens, or a monument that lifts the ambience of a whole quarter, does far more for your society than decorating one house.$(br2)Aim for a handful of impressive communal buildings surrounded by modest homes — a real town silhouette, and the most efficient path to a contented, climbing population.
